Nice cross!
Mar 2025 • Couples
Nice cross. Very delicious and varied dishes, and not only classics, but also experiments. Dishes and sauces are initially served moderately spicy, and for those who want spicier there is always a bottle of Tabasco on the table. Fresh and well served. Honestly, in Mexican cuisine, I've always hated their taco chips, for being fat and having a belly-heavy after them. But instead, they have the thinnest fila dough chips, and you actually enjoy the toppings, and the chips themselves are delicious but not felt and you can eat them all you want. I really liked the kitchen and the interior. The kitchen is open... the guys cook clean and neat. Alcohol, of course, poked and cocktails with her, etc. The interior is simplistic, but certainly Mexican style and you can take pictures in sambrero. Problem of course feeding the baby... we only ordered fries. So it's only for adults. Visitors are predominantly European. 🔥
After a trip to Mexico, there's a lot to compare, but this restaurant can safely be put in one of the best. Definitely recommended.
